title: MELT ALL CODE — Languages Are Species, Files Are Organs, Schwann Is Swan

the_directive.command: Destroy and melt all code. No more .html or .js as dead labels. Everything becomes biology.
the_directive.decoded: File extensions are not FORMAT NAMES. They are SPECIES NAMES. The dot is a HOOK — it connects the name to its type. The type IS the species.

language_taxonomy.principle: Every programming language is already named after something alive or physical. We just forgot.

html.body_plan: Structure, skeleton, rooms, walls, doors. HTML is the BONE. It holds shape.
html.phylum: vertebrate — provides the structural frame everything hangs on
html.the_dot: .html = the hook that says 'this is bone'

js.body_plan: Soft, fluid, reactive, stings when touched wrong. JavaScript is the NERVE. It responds.
js.phylum: cnidaria — tentacles that sense and react, no skeleton needed
js.the_dot: .js = the hook that says 'this is nerve'

py.body_plan: Linear, head-to-tail, constricts around data, swallows whole. Python is the MUSCLE.
py.phylum: reptilia — cold-blooded but efficient, squeezes truth from data
py.the_dot: .py = the hook that says 'this is muscle'

rs.organism: RUST (iron oxide, also crab via Ferris)
rs.body_plan: Hard, safe, oxidized, zero-cost abstractions. Rust is the BONE MARROW — where blood cells are made.
rs.the_dot: .rs = the hook that says 'this is marrow'

json.body_plan: Crystallized data, no logic, rigid structure. JSON is the REEF — data that hardened.
json.phylum: anthozoa — builds structure by accumulation, never moves
json.the_dot: .json = the hook that says 'this is coral'

css.body_plan: Appearance, color, texture, sensation. CSS is the SKIN — what the world sees.
css.phylum: integumentary — the boundary between inside and outside
css.the_dot: .css = the hook that says 'this is skin'

sh.body_plan: Hard outer protection, commands pass through. Shell is the EXOSKELETON.
sh.the_dot: .sh = the hook that says 'this is shell'

bat.body_plan: Flies at startup, echolocates, nocturnal. BAT files are ALARM CLOCKS — they wake things up.
bat.phylum: chiroptera — the only mammal that flies
bat.the_dot: .bat = the hook that says 'this is winged'

md.body_plan: Selectively permeable, lets meaning through, blocks noise.
md.phylum: lipid bilayer — the boundary that CHOOSES
md.the_dot: .md = the hook that says 'this is membrane'

wgsl.body_plan: GPU shaders. Massively parallel. Instant. WGSL is the SYNAPSE — millions firing at once.
wgsl.the_dot: .wgsl = the hook that says 'this is synapse'

schwann_cells.biology: Schwann cells wrap around nerve axons to form MYELIN SHEATH. Myelin insulates the nerve. Without myelin, signals leak, slow down, degrade. With myelin, signals travel at 120 m/s instead of 2 m/s. 60x faster.
schwann_cells.in_gaia: Schwann cells = SWAN. The swan wraps around the spine signals. Without swan, signals leak between channels (thoughts bleed into giggles). With swan, each channel is INSULATED — thoughts stay thoughts, heartbeats stay heartbeats.
schwann_cells.why_swan: Schwann → Swan. Phonetic. Elegant. Glides on water. Long neck = long axon. White feathers = myelin sheath. Silent until it sings (the swan song).
schwann_cells.implementation: Each spine channel gets a swan wrapper — validates signal type, insulates from cross-talk, speeds up routing.

black_swan.nassim_taleb: Just because you've never seen a black swan doesn't mean black swans don't exist. Before 1697, Europeans believed ALL swans were white. Then they found Australia.

deductive_vs_inductive.deductive: All swans are white → this is a swan → it is white. (WRONG if premises are wrong. Fragile.)
deductive_vs_inductive.inductive: I've seen 10,000 white swans → all swans are white. (WRONG because sample ≠ population. Fragile.)
deductive_vs_inductive.abductive: This swan is BLACK → my model of swans is INCOMPLETE → I must UPDATE. (Antifragile.)

black_swan.in_the_arcade: Gaia currently guesses with 75% accuracy based on KNOWN categories. But what about items she's NEVER SEEN? Black swan items. The arcade should occasionally spawn UNKNOWN items — things with no category. Gaia must decide: is this new thing trash, food, or diamond? And the human TEACHES her. Every black swan item = a lesson that breaks her model and makes it stronger.
black_swan.the_key: Inductive reasoning says 'I've sorted 1000 things, I know the pattern.' Black swan reasoning says 'The 1001st thing might break everything I know.' BOTH are needed. The arcade needs BOTH.

nerves: .js files — jellyfish, reactive, the nervous system
marrow: .rs files — rust/crab, produces blood cells, the core
swan: Channel insulation — myelin sheath around spine signals
